Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: Identifies beginning of new message and protocol version. ALWAYS the first field in the message. Must be set to 4.2

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Message length, in bytes, forward to the CheckSum field. ALWAYS the second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Defines message type. ALWAYS the third field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Integer message sequence number. The first message of the day starts with sequence number = 1.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Indicates possible retransmission of message with this sequence number.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time of message transmission, in UTC.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: Assigned value used to identify the firm sending the message.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Assigned value used to identify the receiving firm.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Value assigned by the firm sending the message.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Assigned value used to identify the firm originating the message if it was delivered by a third party. This field is not echoed back.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: Assigned value used to identify a specific message originator (i.e. trader) if the message was delivered by a third party. This field is not echoed back.

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Will echo the SenderCompID of the session that originated the order. Only present on Drop Copy connections.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Three byte, simple checksum. ALWAYS the last field in the message; it serves, with the trailing <SOH>, as the end-of-message delimiter.

Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: The Logon message must be the first message received by CIX after the TCP connection is established by the member. CIX will close the TCP socket after 5 seconds if no Logon message is received.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: If present, must be 0 (no encryption).

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Member heartbeat interval (in seconds).

Message.Name: Heartbeat
Message.Description: The heartbeat maintains the FIX connection during periods of inactivity. A heartbeat message is sent only if no other message has been sent during the preceding HeartbeatInterval.

Message.Name: TestRequest
Message.Description: The test request message forces a heartbeat from the opposing application.

Message.Name: ResendRequest
Message.Description: The resend request is sent by the receiving application to initiate the retransmission of messages.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of the first message in the range to be resent.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of the last message in the range to be resent. If the request is for a single message, BeginSeqNo = EndSeqNo. If the request is for all messages subsequent to a particular message, EndSeqNo = 0 (zero).

Message.Name: Reject
Message.Description: The reject message will be issued when a message is received but cannot be properly processed due to a session-level violation.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of the rejected message.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify the reason for a session-level Reject message.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text.

Message.Name: SequenceReset
Message.Description: The Sequence Reset message is used by the sending application to reset the incoming sequence number on the opposing side.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Indicates whether the Sequence Reset is a Gap Fill or a Reset.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New sequence number.

Message.Name: Logout
Message.Description: The logout message initiates or confirms the termination of the FIX session.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Optional text.

Message.Name: NewOrderSingle
Message.Description: New Order Single. If a New Order Single is received with invalid values or missing required tags, an Execution Report message will be sent in response with a rejected OrdStatus. Upon receipt of an accepted New Order message, an ack message will be sent out with a new OrdStatus per FIX standards.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Account Field, if sent, will be echoed back to the client in the Execution msg. 1*32 alphanumeric.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for Order as assigned by the order sender. Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day per symbol across all sessions. 1*32 alphanumeric.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: For Pegs, OrdType(40) MUST be equal to P. If ExecInst=f, it will override any HandlInst(21) and the order will be treated as DAO.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: Will be defaulted to 1 (OPR Reprice) if not received. If ExecInst=f, it will override HandlInst(21) and the order will be treated as DAO.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of shares. Precise to 6 decimals for support of fractional shares.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: If 40=P, then 18 MUST be M, R, or P.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price per share. Must not be present when 40=1. Required when 40=2. Optional when 40=P.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the order.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Ticker Symbol. Must be 11 characters or less.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect. GTT = Good Till Time; essentially a same-day GTD order with a specified expiry time prior to market close. For GTT, it must be combined with ExpireTime(126) using the current date to specify the expiry time of the order. Any date other than current, if provided in ExpireTime(126), will result in an order rejection.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of Order creation expressed in UTC. See Appendix C for more details.

Field.Name: ExDestination
Field.Description: Specify which book to send the order to. For Midpoint Peg orders, 100 MUST be set to INCC. Ignored on replaces.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum Acceptable Quantity (MAQ): Minimum quantity of each execution report. Orders will not interact with smaller sized contra orders. Order will be rejected if Bypass=Y is combined with MinQty. Only accepted on non-display orders such as IOC and Midpoint orders.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: The quantity to be displayed, in board lot sizes only. If MaxFloor(111)=0 on a visible order, then the entire order quantity is hidden. See Appendix B for more details.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Conditionally required if TimeInForce(59) is set to GTT(6). Expressed in UTC.

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: Identifies the type of customer sending the order.

Field.Name: RoutingArrangementIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates whether a routing arrangement is in place.

Field.Name: UMIRAccountType
Field.Description: Required for Canadian regulatory reporting. If not provided on a MsgType(35) = D (a New Order Single), will default to value NC, which will be echoed back on the Execution Reports.

Field.Name: UMIRUserID
Field.Description: Required for Canadian regulatory reporting, the trading system's user ID for the trader. 1*8 alphanumeric.

Field.Name: BasketTrade
Field.Description: Identification for order as part of a basket trade. May carry a 15 digit Basket Number.

Field.Name: ProgramTrade
Field.Description: Identify this order as part of a program trade. Allowed values: Y, N.

Field.Name: Jitney
Field.Description: Broker on whose behalf this order is being submitted if different from the executing broker. This is a 3-digit numeric identifier per BrokerNumber(6774).

Field.Name: Anonymous
Field.Description: Anonymize this order when trade reporting. Allowed values: Y, N. Default is N.

Field.Name: UMIRRegulationID
Field.Description: Identification marker for UMIR-specific designations to orders and trades.

Field.Name: BrokerNumber
Field.Description: Three digit private PO number identifying a Member Firm. Anonymous orders are assigned a public broker number of 001.

Field.Name: Bypass
Field.Description: Indicates the order should only trade with displayed volumes. These orders are treated as IOC. Default is N. Order will be rejected if Bypass=Y is combined with MinQty.

Field.Name: NoTradeFeat
Field.Description: Code that defines self-trade prevention behavior for orders from the same broker. If there are conflicting instructions, the newer order's instructions shall take precedence.

Field.Name: NoTradeKey
Field.Description: Self-cross trade prevention ID generated by participant. 1*6 alphanumeric.

Field.Name: ShortMarkingExempt
Field.Description: Identifies an order as Short Marking Exempt (SME). Not valid on short sell orders.

Field.Name: POComment
Field.Description: Free form pass-through tag. 1*32 alphanumeric.

Field.Name: DisplayRange
Field.Description: A quantity added and subtracted to the MaxFloor(111) of an Iceberg order to define a range from which the iceberg's display volume is randomly chosen. E.g. MaxFloor(111)=1000 and DisplayRange(8020)=200 will allow random display volumes of 800, 900, 1000, 1100, or 1200.

Field.Name: CustomerAccount
Field.Description: Account number for clients not eligible to obtain an LEI. 1*20 alphanumeric.

Field.Name: AlgorithmID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for the end-client (orders automatically generated on a predetermined basis). 1*20 alphanumeric.

Field.Name: CustomerLEI
Field.Description: LEI for clients eligible to obtain an LEI including LEI of the foreign dealer equivalent (encryption required). 1*52 alphanumeric.

Field.Name: BrokerLEI
Field.Description: Non-PO IIROC Dealer Member (correspondent broker) LEI. 1*20 alphanumeric.

Field.Name: MinQtyAggregation
Field.Description: Instruction for setting MinQty to permit the aggregation of contra-side interest to meet the minimum quantity requirements. Note that orders are not bunched into one fill. If MinQty(110) is not present on order, then MinQtyAggregation(9110) will be ignored. Ignored on replaces.

Field.Name: FractionalTradeRelatedIdentification
Field.Description: Identifies fractional client orders intended as fractional clean up orders (FRC).

Field.Name: RoutingInst
Field.Description: Applicable to ALO orders only in the ASPEN and ASPEN VERT order books.

Message.Name: OrderCancelRequest
Message.Description: Request to fully cancel the remaining open shares on the order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the cancel request as assigned by the order sender.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of shares on the order being cancelled.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order type of the original order.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID(11) of the order to be cancelled.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the original order.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Ticker Symbol of the original order.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of cancel request creation expressed in UTC.

Message.Name: OrderCancelReplaceRequest
Message.Description: Request to modify the parameters of an existing open order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the replacement request as assigned by the order sender.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: For Pegs, OrdType(40) MUST be equal to P.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: Will be defaulted to 1 (OPR Reprice) if not received.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: New number of shares. Precise to 6 decimals for support of fractional shares.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: If 40=P, then 18 MUST be M, R, or P.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID(11) of the order to be replaced.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: New price per share. Must not be present when 40=1. Required when 40=2. Optional when 40=P.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the order.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Ticker Symbol. Must be 11 characters or less.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of replacement request creation expressed in UTC.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum Acceptable Quantity (MAQ). Only accepted on non-display orders such as IOC and Midpoint orders.

Message.Name: ExecutionReport
Message.Description: The Execution Report message is used to confirm the receipt of an order, confirm changes to an existing order, relay order status information, relay fill information on working orders, or reject an order.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Calculated average price of all fills on this order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the most recent order as assigned by the order sender.

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Total number of shares filled on this order.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Currency of the order.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of this execution report as assigned by CIX.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Reference to the ExecID(17) of the original execution being cancelled or corrected. Present when ExecTransType(20) = 1 or 2.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: Identifies transaction type.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: Market of execution for the last fill.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of the last fill.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of shares on the last fill.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for the order as assigned by CIX.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of shares on the order.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Identifies current status of order.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID(11) of the previous order when responding to a cancel or cancel/replace request.

Field.Name: OrigTime
Field.Description: Time of original order creation expressed in UTC.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free-form text with additional details.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time this execution report was generated, expressed in UTC.

Field.Name: OrdRejReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for order rejection.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Describes the specific ExecutionRpt (ie Pending Cancel) while OrdStatus will always identify the current order status (ie Partially Filled).

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Quantity open for further execution. Precise to 6 decimals for support of fractional order quantities.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: The broker with whom the trade occurred. Format and values will be as described for BrokerNumber(6774).

Field.Name: ExecRestatementReason
Field.Description: Only present when 150=D or 150=3.

Field.Name: LastLiquidityInd
Field.Description: Indicator to identify whether a fill or partial fill was the result of a liquidity code.

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: RoutingArrangementIndicator
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: UMIRAccountType
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: UMIRUserID
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: BasketTrade
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: ProgramTrade
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: Jitney
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: Anonymous
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: UMIRRegulationID
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: BrokerNumber
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: PrincipalTrade
Field.Description: A principal transaction between a dealer and a dealer's customer account.

Field.Name: WashTrade
Field.Description: A trade that has occurred between proprietary accounts of the same member firm.

Field.Name: Bypass
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: NoTradeFeat
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: NoTradeKey
Field.Description: Will match original order unless it was not provided, in which case it will be NC.

Field.Name: ShortMarkingExempt
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: MatchingPriority
Field.Description: The type of priority used to match an order in a trade. May only be present if 150 = 1 or 2 (partial fill or fill).

Field.Name: ExecuteMatch
Field.Description: Trade matched and suppressed due to no self-trade.

Field.Name: POComment
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: CustomerAccount
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: AlgorithmID
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: CustomerLEI
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: BrokerLEI
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: MinQtyAggregation
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: RoutingInst
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Message.Name: OrderCancelReject
Message.Description: A reject in response to a cancel or Cancel/Replace request.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: The unique ClOrdID as specified on the original Cancel or Cancel/Replace request that is being rejected.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: The OrderID is the order intended for cancellation or replacement. Will return value NONE if original order not found.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Identifies current status of order.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: The OrigClOrdID as specified on the original Cancel or Cancel/Replace request.

Field.Name: CxlRejReason
Field.Description: Code to identify the reason for cancel rejection.

Field.Name: CxlRejResponseTo
Field.Description: Identifies the request this reject is in response to.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Textual description of the reject reason.
